label: Fast Warp
summary: Makes warp-room teleports much quicker: the white fade-out/fade-in runs 4-6 times faster in both castles and the inverted-castle warp platform moves 4 times faster.

edits.why: WRP EntityWarpRoom step 3: Alucard fade-to-white +2 -> +8 per frame
WRP step 4: room fade (prim 1) +2 -> +12 per frame
WRP step 4: room fade (prim 2) +2 -> +12 per frame
WRP step 7: fade-in from white -4 -> -16 per frame
RWRP step 2: warp platform rises 1 -> 4 px per frame
RWRP step 8: platform lowers 1 -> 4 px per frame
RWRP step 8: player posY follows platform +1 -> +4

vanilla.reason: Only immediate operands of addiu instructions inside EntityWarpRoom change; vanilla bytes equal the off bytes and nothing else is referenced.

overlaps.detail: WRP/RWRP also carry the Reawakened damage-number hooks (0xA74, 0x8FC8/0xAF48, 0x9BA8/0xBB28); different bytes, independent.

notes: All 12 bytes are identical to the Reawakened PPF (attributed to "Sotn - Reawakend - BIN unico.ppf"); o==v at every location. Every edit is a step-size immediate, so no tunables are marked (marking them would leave nothing to detect). Each changed fade still stops at its clamp (r0 < 0xF0/0xF8, temp < 0 -> 0, platform Y clamped to 0x90/0xC0), so larger steps cannot overshoot.
